open_points: Wave 1 formats are read from the files as made: they hold the files to their present shape, not to an ideal one. The keeper may tighten them.
paper-map.svg and map-topdown.svg are drawings, checked by rule in validate_data.py (made from map.json, every place mark present), not by schema.
dialect: subset of JSON Schema: type, required, properties, items, additionalProperties, enum, minimum, maximum, pattern, minLength, minItems, maxItems; plus tuple (a list of item schemas by position) and oneKeyOf (exactly one of these keys)

people/<id>.json.x-made: by hand from TECH-PLAN section 3 (people); waits on the story frame

kind.x-note: TECH-PLAN section 3 kinds plus officer (wave 2 added it; the keeper should add it to TECH-PLAN or fold officers into minor)

sched.x-note: [fromHour, where (a places.json id or a map.json door id for a home), act, days?]; DERIVED from routines.json, which is the one home of the routine (validate_data.py checks they agree)

own.x-note: line ids in lines/, or a TO WRITE marker string until the story lane writes them

card.x-note: fire, rivals and secret (TECH-PLAN section 3) are expected for principals and named regulars; the reviewer of wave 2 judges which

x-rules: age 18 or over: no children anywhere (canon)
every sched place is a places.json id or a map.json door id
name_ladder on frank_nowak: the new owner, Nowak, Frank, Frankie; nobody says Tom or Tommy (decision of 24 Nov)

cast.json.x-made: wave 2 (24 Nov 2026): the index of people/, the fighter kinds (1.3.12) and the rule that will make the residents

ties.json.x-made: by hand from TECH-PLAN section 3 (ties, the real town's form)

x-rules: every place is a places.json id, a map.json door id (a home) or a routines.json provisional_places id
a move between consecutive rows is reachable on the map graph at walking pace in the game time between them (the 200 m walking-reach rule checked on the 120 s hour)

who.x-note: a people/ id, or kind:<speaker kind> for shared street lines

situation.x-note: from the fixed line table (FIT F19); the table is listed in lines/situations.json when made

x-rules: no line names a real brand, person or anything after 1992
every step "at" is a places.json or rooms.json id
every break-in step has three keys

happenings.json.x-made: by hand from TECH-PLAN section 3 (scenes and happenings) and DEFINITIONS G6

items.x-note: each beat is exactly one of {say: line id}, {choose: [...]}, {walk: who, to}, {do: act}, {wait: real seconds}

side-stories/<id>.json.x-made: by hand from the sweep (file 11) and the job shape

scenes/<id>.json.x-made: by hand from TECH-PLAN section 3 (scenes); waits on the story pick

when.x-note: a state condition, never a clock time alone

items.x-note: each beat is exactly one of {say: line id}, {choose: [...]}, {walk: who, to}, {do: act}, {wait: real seconds}

cross_checks: every door, plot, road and place id named by rooms, places, police, vehicles, crowd and timetables exists in map.json
every room prompt id exists in ui-text.json, or is listed in rooms.json new_prompts_needed
every room reverb kind exists in sounds.json
every tune:<key> reference in any file exists in tune.json
no file contains a word from content-words.json patterns in player-facing text (screen only, with the out-of-fiction exemptions)
the paper map has one place mark for every map place
